v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Vidi civitátem sanctam, Ierúsalem novam, descendéntem de cælo a Deo, parátam sicut sponsam ornátam viro suo.
text.en: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a Bride adorned for her husband.

v.en: Holiness becometh thine house, O Lord.

text.la: O quam metuéndus est * locus iste: vere non est hic áliud, nisi domus Dei, et porta cæli.
text.en: How dreadful is this place. * Surely this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

text.la: In Anniversario Dedicationis Ecclesiæ Deus, qui nobis per síngulos annos huius sancti templi tui consecratiónis réparas diem, et sacris semper mystériis repræséntas incólumes: exáudi preces pópuli tui, et præsta; ut quisquis hoc templum benefícia petitúrus ingréditur, cuncta se impetrásse lætétur.
text.en: Prayer on the anniversary of the dedication: O God, who dost every year bring round unto us again the day whereon this thine holy temple was hallowed, and bringest us again in soundness of body and mind to be present at thine holy worship, graciously hear the supplications of thy people, and grant that whosoever shall come into this thine house to ask good at thine hand, may be rejoiced in the obtaining of all his request.

office.title: In Dedicatione Basilicarum Ss. Apostolorum Petri et Pauli
